title: Quietly Umami Greek Eggplant Stew
description: A nostalgic and savory Greek stew featuring eggplant, red pepper paste, and a rich umami flavor, all in a vegan-friendly package.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the diced eggplant and cook until it begins to soften, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the red pepper paste, tomato paste, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the vegetable broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the eggplant is tender, about 20 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to emulsify the stew, or allow it to cool and puree it in a blender.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
